name: en_home_sweep
title: English UI — Home sweep + launch every experience pack
persona: An onboarded English+Spanish learner exploring Home. Sweeps the Home hub (For you hero, Show me another, Recommended, Browse phrase packs, all-packs listing, Plus chip), then deep-links into each of the eight experiences via ?game=<id>, screenshots it, and moves on. Pack→pack navigation reuses goto (replaces the ?game= param); a final clean re-entry returns to Home.

beats.narrate: Seed an onboarded English + Spanish stack (merges into the active stack, reloads).
Confirm the Settings gear is present + on-screen.
For you hero — cycle to the next recommendation (Show me another).
Cycle once more to show the carousel is live.
Browse phrase packs — opens the shared phrase-pack drawer.
Reload to dismiss the drawer and return to a clean Home.
Launch Phrase Flip (phrase_main) — the native phrase experience.
Confirm the in-pack Quick settings gear + Home button chrome is present.
Clean re-entry to Home (strip ?game=, restore onboarded).
Restore the onboarded stack so Home renders (not onboarding).
